description:
All your AI subscription limits in one liquid-glass tray popover.

Pane shows how much of your session and weekly limits each AI tool has left,
directly from the Windows system tray. It auto-detects the CLIs and apps you
already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Grok and more - 18
providers), projects whether you will run out before the reset, computes
local spend with live model pricing, and updates itself via signed releases.
No telemetry; tokens only ever go to their own vendor's API.
What's Changed
- Bound json_body reads chunk-by-chunk instead of buffering the whole body by @LJC-god in #205
- Keep a corrupt config.json from overwriting the last good backup by @ItsJazii in #208
- Isolate cached state when a pasted API key is rotated by @ItsJazii in #209
- Check for updates on every popover open again by @ItsJazii in #210
- Release 0.4.50 by @ItsJazii in #211
New Contributors
- @LJC-god made their first contribution in #205
